-- CONFIGURATION
local Settings = {
LeaveOnCreator = true, -- Auto-leave if the game creator joins the server
LeaveOnRobloxAdmin = true, -- Auto-leave if an official Roblox staff member joins

-- Custom lists (Add specific usernames or IDs you want to avoid)
TargetUsernames = {"nameofmod", "GameOwnerFriend"},
TargetUserIds = {1234567, 8901234},

-- Group checking (Optional: kicks you if someone with a high rank in the game's main group joins)
CheckGroupRole = true,
GroupId = game.CreatorId, -- Automatically defaults to the game creator's ID/Group if applicable
MinRankToKick = 200 -- Usually, 200+ are mods/admins in development groups
}

-- SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- LOG FUNCTION
local function debugLog(message)
print("[Anti-Mod]: " .. message)
end

-- DETECTION FUNCTION
local function checkPlayer(player)
if player == LocalPlayer then return end

-- 1. Check if Creator
if Settings.LeaveOnCreator and player.UserId == game.CreatorId then
LocalPlayer:Kick("⚠️ Detected Game Creator: " .. player.Name)
return
end

-- 2. Check if Official Roblox Admin/Staff
if Settings.LeaveOnRobloxAdmin and player:IsInGroup(1200769) then -- 1200769 is the official Roblox Admin group ID
LocalPlayer:Kick("⚠️ Detected Official Roblox Staff/Admin: " .. player.Name)
return
end

-- 3. Check Username Custom List
for _, name in ipairs(Settings.TargetUsernames) do
if player.Name:lower() == name:lower() then
LocalPlayer:Kick("⚠️ Detected Blacklisted Username: " .. player.Name)
return
end
end

-- 4. Check UserID Custom List
for _, id in ipairs(Settings.TargetUserIds) do
if player.UserId == id then
LocalPlayer:Kick("⚠️ Detected Blacklisted UserID: " .. player.Name)
return
end
end

-- 5. Check Group Rank (if the game is owned by a group)
if Settings.CheckGroupRole and game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group then
pcall(function()
if player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId) >= Settings.MinRankToKick then
LocalPlayer:Kick("⚠️ Detected Game Group Moderator/Admin: " .. player.Name)
end
end)
end
end

-- SCAN EXISTING PLAYERS
debugLog("Scanning current server players...")
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
checkPlayer(player)
end

-- LISTEN FOR NEW PLAYERS JOINING
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
debugLog("Player joined: " .. player.Name .. " | Scanning...")
checkPlayer(player)
end)

debugLog("Anti-Mod Script Successfully Loaded.")

scripts.script:
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
	local UIS              = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TeleportService  = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local player           = Players.LocalPlayer

	local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G"
	local GATE_SECONDS = 15

	local uc = {
		Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
		Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),
		SurfaceHi = Color3.fromRGB(38, 14, 14),
		Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
		Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
		Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
		On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
		Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
	}

	local function make(className, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
	end

	local function copyDiscord()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then
				setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			elseif toclipboard then
				toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			end
		end)
		return ok
	end

	-- ---------- feature state ----------
	local infJumpConn, noclipConn, flyConn, flyBV
	local savedLighting
	local savedSpeed, savedJumpPower, savedUseJumpPower
	local speedBoostOn, jumpPowerOn = false, false

	local function setInfiniteJump(on)
		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedSpeed == nil then savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = 100
		elseif savedSpeed ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
			savedSpeed = nil
		end
	end

	local function setJumpPower(on)
		jumpPowerOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedJumpPower == nil then
				savedJumpPower    = hum.JumpPower
				savedUseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		elseif savedJumpPower ~= nil then
			hum.JumpPower     = savedJumpPower
			hum.UseJumpPower  = savedUseJumpPower
			savedJumpPower    = nil
			savedUseJumpPower = nil
		end
	end

	local function resetCharacter()
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
	end

	local function rejoinServer()
		pcall(function()
			TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player)
		end)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if not hum then return end
		if speedBoostOn then hum.WalkSpeed = 100 end
		if jumpPowerOn then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		end
	end)

	-- =========================================================
	-- SPLASH — 15 second Discord gate
	-- =========================================================
	local function showSplash(onDone)
		local splash = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosSplash",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			IgnoreGuiInset = true,
			DisplayOrder = 200,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)

		local card = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 300),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)
		corner(card, 14)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "HACKING BROS",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 20,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 16),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 50),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "FULL SCRIPT · JOIN DISCORD",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 76),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Copy the invite link and hop in for the full release. The free UI below unlocks once the timer runs out.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		}, card)

		local linkBox = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 38),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 148),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G",
			Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
		}, card)
		corner(linkBox, 8)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, linkBox)

		local copyBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 198),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Discord,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "Copy Discord Invite",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, card)
		corner(copyBtn, 8)

		copyBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			copyDiscord()
			copyBtn.Text = "Copied — see you inside ✓"
			copyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = uc.On
			copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end)

		local countdown = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -38),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = ("UI unlocks in %ds…"):format(GATE_SECONDS),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		local start = os.clock()
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				local remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(GATE_SECONDS - (os.clock() - start)))
				countdown.Text = ("UI unlocks in %ds…"):format(remaining)
				if remaining <= 0 then break end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			splash:Destroy()
			onDone()
		end)
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- MAIN UI
	-- =========================================================
	local function buildUI()
		local screen2 = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosGui",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
			DisplayOrder = 101,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		-- -- persistent Discord button (top-right of screen)
		local dcBar = make("Frame", {
			Name = "DiscordBar",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 40),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, screen2)
		corner(dcBar, 8)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Discord, Thickness = 1 }, dcBar)

		local dcBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, dcBar)

		local dcLabel = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Join DC for full script",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, dcBtn)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -9),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "›",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 16,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
		}, dcBtn)

		dcBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			copyDiscord()
			dcLabel.Text = "Link copied ✓"
			task.delay(1.4, function()
				if dcLabel.Parent then
					dcLabel.Text = "Join DC for full script"
				end
			end)
		end)

		-- -- main panel
		local PANEL_W, PANEL_H = 340, 360

		local panel2 = make("Frame", {
			Name = "Panel",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Active = true,
		}, screen2)
		corner(panel2, 10)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, panel2)

		local header2 = make("Frame", {
			Name = "Header",
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Active = true,
		}, panel2)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "HACKING BROS",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, header2)

		local minBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 12),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "–",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 20,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, header2)

		local close2 = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 12),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "×",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 22,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, header2)

		make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 1),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 48),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Border,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, panel2)

		local content = make("Frame", {
			Name = "Content",
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, -60),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 56),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		}, panel2)
		make("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
		}, content)

		local function makeToggle(order, label, callback)
			local btn = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
				BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				LayoutOrder = order,
			}, content)
			corner(btn, 6)
			local stroke = make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, btn)

			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = label,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = uc.Text,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			}, btn)

			local status = make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0.3, -14, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "OFF",
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			}, btn)

			local state = false
			local function render()
				status.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
				status.TextColor3 = state and uc.On or uc.Muted
				stroke.Color = state and uc.On or uc.Border
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and uc.SurfaceHi or uc.Surface
			end
			render()

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				state = not state
				render()
				local ok, err = pcall(callback, state)
				if not ok then
					warn("[HackingBros] " .. label .. ": " .. tostring(err))
					state = false
					render()
				end
			end)
			return btn
		end

		local function makeAction(order, label, callback)
			local btn = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
				BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				LayoutOrder = order,
			}, content)
			corner(btn, 6)
			make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, btn)

			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = label,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = uc.Text,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			}, btn)

			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -10),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "›",
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextSize = 16,
				TextColor3 = uc.On,
			}, btn)

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				pcall(callback)
			end)
			return btn
		end

		makeToggle(1, "Infinite Jump",            setInfiniteJump)
		makeToggle(2, "Noclip",                   setNoclip)
		makeToggle(3, "Fullbright",               setFullbright)
		makeToggle(4, "Fly  (WASD/Space/Ctrl)",   setFly)
		makeToggle(5, "Speed Boost",              setSpeedBoost)
		makeToggle(6, "High Jump",                setJumpPower)
		makeAction(7, "Reset Character",          resetCharacter)
		makeAction(8, "Rejoin Server",            rejoinServer)

		local minimized = false
		minBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			minimized = not minimized
			if minimized then
				content.Visible = false
				panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, 48)
				minBtn.Text = "+"
			else
				content.Visible = true
				panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H)
				minBtn.Text = "–"
			end
		end)

		close2.Activated:Connect(function()
			if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
			if noclipConn  then noclipConn:Disconnect();  noclipConn  = nil end
			if flyConn     then flyConn:Disconnect();     flyConn     = nil end
			if flyBV       then flyBV:Destroy();          flyBV       = nil end
			setFullbright(false)
			screen2:Destroy()
		end)

		-- -- drag
		local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		header2.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging  = true
				dragInput = input
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos  = panel2.Position

local function SetupToolWithRemotes(tool)
	if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Massless = true
		end
	end

	for _, scriptItem in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if scriptItem:IsA("LocalScript") then
			scriptItem.Disabled = false
		end
	end

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char then return end

		for _, child in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:IsA("Animation") then
				local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid then
					local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid
					local track = animator:LoadAnimation(child)
					track:Play()
				end
			elseif child:IsA("Sound") then
				child:Play()
			end
		end

		for _, item in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
			if item:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				pcall(function() item:FireServer() end)
			end
		end
		
		for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do

local size = 28

if getgenv().Hitbox_Expander then getgenv().Hitbox_Expander() end

local old = getgenv().DidHit or base.DidHit
getgenv().DidHit = old

local ball = Instance.new("Part")
ball.Name = "hitbox"
ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
ball.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * (size * 2)
ball.Transparency = 0.8
ball.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
ball.Anchored = true
ball.CanCollide = false
ball.CanQuery = false
ball.CanTouch = false
ball.CastShadow = false
ball.Parent = workspace

local con
con = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			ball.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
			return
		end
	end
	ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
end)

base.DidHit = function(self, pos, radius)
	return old(self, pos, size)
end

getgenv().Hitbox_Expander = function()
	if con then
		con:Disconnect()
		con = nil
	end
	if ball then
		ball:Destroy()
	end
	base.DidHit = old
	getgenv().Hitbox_Expander = nil
end

scripts.script:
-- =====================================================
-- HABILIDAD ESPIA: Tablet + Nanobot con cara de camara
-- 1) Equipa la "Spy Tablet" del inventario (se abre la lista de jugadores)
-- 2) Elige un jugador: el nanobot vuela hasta su cabeza y entra en ella
-- 3) Ves por sus ojos. "Players" para cambiar de jugador, "Exit" para salir
-- =====================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- ===== ajustes =====

local BOT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255)
local FOV_SPY = 80                            -- campo de vision al espiar

local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

local fxFolder = new("Folder", {Name = "SpyFX"}, workspace)

-- ===== nanobot con cara de camara =====
local function makeBot()
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	local parts = {}
	local function add(size, shape, color, neon, pos, rot, spin)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		if shape then p.Shape = shape end
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = neon and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Metal
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Parent = m
		table.insert(parts, {part = p, size = size, pos = pos, rot = rot, spin = spin})
		return p
	end
	local CYL, BALL = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.PartType.Ball
	local AX = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)   -- cilindro apuntando al frente
	local AY = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))   -- cilindro vertical
	local body = add(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), BALL, Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 90), false, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), CFrame.new(), false)
	add(Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 1), CYL, Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16), false, Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.65), AX, false)
	add(Vector3.new(0.12, 0.6, 0.6), CYL, BOT_COLOR, true, Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.82), AX, false)
	local halo = add(Vector3.new(0.1, 2.3, 2.3), CYL, BOT_COLOR, true, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), AY, true)
	halo.Transparency = 0.4
	add(Vector3.new(0.12, 0.8, 0.12), nil, Color3.fromRGB(190, 195, 210), false, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0.1), CFrame.new(), false)
	add(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), BALL, BOT_COLOR, true, Vector3.new(0, 1.45, 0.1), CFrame.new(), false)
	m.PrimaryPart = body
	m.Parent = fxFolder

	local a0 = new("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0.6)}, body)
	local a1 = new("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.4, 0.6)}, body)
	new("Trail", {
		Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Lifetime = 0.35, LightEmission = 1,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(BOT_COLOR),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)}),
	}, body)
	new("PointLight", {Color = BOT_COLOR, Range = 14, Brightness = 2}, body)
	return {model = m, parts = parts}
end

local function placeBot(b, cf, scale, t)
	for _, e in ipairs(b.parts) do
		local rot = e.rot
		if e.spin then rot = CFrame.Angles(0, t * 9, 0) * e.rot end
		e.part.Size = e.size * scale
		e.part.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(e.pos * scale) * rot
	end
end

local function flyBot(b, startPos, getDest, onDone)
	local pos = startPos
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local con
	con = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local dest = getDest()
		if not dest then
			con:Disconnect()
			onDone(false)
			return
		end
		local d = dest - pos
		local dist = d.Magnitude
		if dist < 1.2 then
			con:Disconnect()
			onDone(true)
			return
		end
		local dir = d.Unit
		pos = pos + dir * math.min(BOT_SPEED * dt, dist)
		local tt = os.clock() - t0
		local wob = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(tt * 9) * 0.5, 0)
		placeBot(b, CFrame.new(pos + wob, pos + wob + dir), 1, tt)
	end)
	table.insert(conns, con)
	return con
end

local function shrinkBot(b, pos, onDone)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local con
	con = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 0.35
		if k >= 1 then
			con:Disconnect()
			onDone()
			return
		end
		placeBot(b, CFrame.new(pos), math.max(1 - k, 0.05), os.clock())
	end)
	table.insert(conns, con)
end

local function burst(pos)
	local p = new("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Position = pos}, fxFolder)
	local e = new("ParticleEmitter", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new(BOT_COLOR), LightEmission = 1, Rate = 0,
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 20),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
		Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)}),
	}, p)
	e:Emit(40)
	task.delay(1.5, function() p:Destroy() end)
end

-- ===== ver por los ojos del jugador =====
local function hideTarget(ch, on)
	if not ch then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Decal") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Head" then
			if on then
				hiddenOrig[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			elseif hiddenOrig[d] ~= nil then
				d.Transparency = hiddenOrig[d]
				hiddenOrig[d] = nil
			end
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and (d.Name == "Head" or (d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("Accoutrement"))) then
			d.LocalTransparencyModifier = on and 1 or 0
		end
	end
end

local function freeze(on)
	local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then
		saved = nil
		return
	end
	if on then
		saved = saved or {ws = hum.WalkSpeed, jp = hum.JumpPower, jh = hum.JumpHeight}
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		hum.JumpPower = 0
		hum.JumpHeight = 0
	elseif saved then
		hum.WalkSpeed = saved.ws
		hum.JumpPower = saved.jp
		hum.JumpHeight = saved.jh
		saved = nil
	end
end

local function stopSpyView()

	hideTarget(hiddenChar, false)
	hiddenChar = nil
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

	state = "spying"
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	cam.FieldOfView = FOV_SPY
	freeze(true)
	panel.Visible = false

	TS:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("SpyCam") end)
	RS:BindToRenderStep("SpyCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		local ch = target and target.Character

			hiddenChar = ch
			hideTarget(ch, true)
		end
		local head = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then cam.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, -0.9) end
	end)
end

local function exitSpy(msg)
	if state ~= "spying" then return end
	local head = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local from = head and head.Position
	stopSpyView()
	target = nil
	if msg then toast(msg, 3) end
	if not from then
		state = "idle"
		return
	end
	state = "returning"
	local b = makeBot()
	bot = b
	flyBot(b, from, function()
		local h = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		return h and h.Position
	end, function()
		b.model:Destroy()
		bot = nil
		state = "idle"
	end)
end

-- ===== enviar el nanobot =====
local function launch(p)
	if state == "flying" or state == "entering" or state == "returning" then
		toast("El nanobot esta ocupado", 2)
		return
	end
	local ch = p.Character
	if not (ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")) then

	local startPos = nil
	if state == "spying" then
		local oh = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		startPos = oh and oh.Position
		stopSpyView()
	end
	if not startPos then
		local lh = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not lh then
			toast("Sin personaje", 2)
			return
		end
		startPos = lh.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	end

	target = p
	state = "flying"
	panel.Visible = false
	toast("Nanobot enviado a " .. p.DisplayName, 3)
	local b = makeBot()
	bot = b
	flyBot(b, startPos, function()
		local h = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		return h and h.Position
	end, function(ok)
		if not ok then
			b.model:Destroy()
			bot = nil
			state = "idle"
			target = nil
			toast("Se perdio la senal del jugador", 3)
			return
		end
		state = "entering"
		local h = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local hp = h and h.Position or startPos
		burst(hp)
		shrinkBot(b, hp, function()
			b.model:Destroy()
			bot = nil
			if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
				startSpy()
			else
				state = "idle"
				target = nil
				toast("Se perdio la senal del jugador", 3)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

-- AutoDodge.lua — open source, no key, no loader
-- Target: Huss Valley (Roblox)
-- Executor: any with loadstring + task.spawn (Volt, Potassium, Delta, Wave, Xeno, Solara)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG = {
    enabled = true,
    range = 28,
    closeRange = 10,       -- studs: extra-tight trigger, dodges even on cooldown tail
    dodgeDistance = 30,
    cooldown = 0.45,
    closeCooldown = 0.25,  -- shorter cooldown when threat is within closeRange
    dodgeKey = Enum.KeyCode.Q,
    useRemote = true,
}

local lastDodge = 0

local function getChar()
    return LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
end
local function getHRP()
    local c = getChar()
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getHum()
    local c = getChar()
    return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getThreats()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return {}, 0 end
    local myPos = hrp.Position
    local out = {}
    local nearest = math.huge

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local otherHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local otherHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if otherHrp and otherHum and otherHum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (otherHrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if d < nearest then nearest = d end
                if d <= CONFIG.range then
                    table.insert(out, {pos = otherHrp.Position, dist = d, obj = p.Character})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hum = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp2 = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp2 and hum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (hrp2.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if d < nearest then nearest = d end
                if d <= CONFIG.range then
                    table.insert(out, {pos = hrp2.Position, dist = d, obj = obj})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return out, nearest
end

local function escapeVector(threats)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp or #threats == 0 then return nil end
    local sum = Vector3.zero
    for _, t in ipairs(threats) do
        sum = sum + t.pos
    end
    local centroid = sum / #threats
    local away = (hrp.Position - centroid)
    if away.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        away = Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1), 0, math.random(-1,1))
    end
    return away.Unit
end

local function fireRemoteDodge(dir)
    if not CONFIG.useRemote then return false end
    local remotes = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            local n = d.Name:lower()
            if n:find("dodge") or n:find("dash") or n:find("tackle") or n:find("evade") then
                table.insert(remotes, d)
            end
        end
    end
    if #remotes == 0 then return false end
    for _, r in ipairs(remotes) do
        pcall(function()
            r:FireServer(dir)
            r:FireServer()
            r:FireServer(dir, true)
        end)
    end
    return true
end

local function velocityDodge(dir)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return end
    local target = hrp.Position + dir * CONFIG.dodgeDistance
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * 90 + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0)
    task.delay(0.12, function()
        if hrp and hrp.Parent then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end)
end

local function doDodge(dir)
    if not fireRemoteDodge(dir) then
        velocityDodge(dir)
    end
    pcall(function()
        local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        vim:SendKeyEvent(true, CONFIG.dodgeKey, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        vim:SendKeyEvent(false, CONFIG.dodgeKey, false, game)
    end)
end

-- ---------- GUI ----------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AutoDodgeGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "Main"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 56)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true              -- built-in drag
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

corner.Parent = frame

stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
stroke.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "AUTO DODGE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 12
title.Parent = frame

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "Toggle"
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
button.BorderSizePixel = 0
button.Text = "ON"
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 13
button.AutoButtonColor = false
button.Parent = frame

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

btnCorner.Parent = button

-- Rainbow: cycle hue on stroke + button background tint
local rainbowConn
local hue = 0
rainbowConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    hue = (hue + dt * 0.35) % 1
    local c = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
    stroke.Color = c
    if CONFIG.enabled then
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 0.35)
    else
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end
end)

local function refreshButton()
    if CONFIG.enabled then
        button.Text = "ON"
    else
        button.Text = "OFF"
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end
end

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.enabled = not CONFIG.enabled
    refreshButton()
end)

-- Drag with touch + mouse (Draggable covers mouse; add touch for mobile)
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function beginDrag(input)
    dragging = true
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPos = frame.Position
    input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end
frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        beginDrag(input)
    end
end)
frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

refreshButton()

-- ---------- Loop ----------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.enabled then return end
    local now = os.clock()

    local hum = getHum()
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    local threats, nearest = getThreats()
    if #threats == 0 then return end

    local cd = (nearest <= CONFIG.closeRange) and CONFIG.closeCooldown or CONFIG.cooldown
    if now - lastDodge < cd then return end

    local dir = escapeVector(threats)
    if not dir then return end

    lastDodge = now
    doDodge(dir)
end)

-- RightShift also toggles
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        CONFIG.enabled = not CONFIG.enabled
        refreshButton()
    end
end)
